name: MissChanger
description: A StealthBurner-based tool changer system for Voron 2.4 that maintains MGN9H tapping accuracy from Voron-Tap. Supports quick, tool-less conversion between tool-changer and single-nozzle mode, with an integrated nozzle brush dock for post-tool-change cleaning. Trident compatibility is planned.
features: Quick, tool-less conversion between tool-changer and single-nozzle mode
MGN9H tapping system for Z probing accuracy
Up to 5 tool stations (350mm) or 4 tool stations (300mm)
Docks run in standard 2020 extrusion grooves
Compatible with Clockwork 2 and Galileo 2 extruders
